Incident Bot: [P1] 3xx OOMs on paged-attn allocator in us-west-2 cluster -> spawning node flaps and container restarts
Julia (oncall): @here seeing a slow increase in OOMs across paged-attn pools. first spike ~02:12 UTC, nodes restarting intermittently. linking graph: https://grafana/redwood/d/abc123/paged-attn
Sam (eng): thanks — can you paste the allocator logs from the most recent restart? suspect KV cache fragmentation + paged slots not being reclaimed.
Julia (oncall): grabbing logs now, pasting tail: ```
[2025-10-21T02:18:04Z] alloc: paged_slot_alloc failed size=256k err=OOM
[2025-10-21T02:18:04Z] kv_cache: pages_in_use=987654 pages_free=12 fragmentation=0.92
[2025-10-21T02:18:04Z] cuda: cuCtxSynchronize -> out of memory
containerd: container exited with code 137
```
Elandra (sre): fragmentation 0.92 is brutal. this is the slow-drip leak we've seen before but different — node flaps started after a service update at 01:40. did we land any allocator change?
Sam (eng): we rolled a minor allocator tweak yesterday (compact-scan backoff increase) which delays aggressive compaction. thinking it degraded long-term compaction when workload is highly variable.
Mike (ml): workload note: longer sequences in model v2.4 are up 2.6x since midnight due to a customer batch replay. that increases KV resident set.
Julia (oncall): customer impact: a small subset of hosted inference requests got 5xx spike; error budget alerts firing. but majority of clusters are fine; this is concentrated to us-west-2 paged pool.
Ops Runner: suggested immediate mitigations: 1) enable emergency compaction on affected nodes 2) drift some requests to cheaper non-paged nodes 3) drain and recycle the worst-off nodes.
Elandra (sre): agree. prioritized steps: 
- toggle compaction to aggressive via /ops/allocator/compact-scan=1
- bump evict_by_age to 30s from 300s for paged-attn pools (will increase evictions but free pages)
- apply a rolling drain to 2 nodes at a time
Julia (oncall): executing commands now, starting with compact toggle. pasting command run: ```bash
curl -X POST https://ops-api/internal/allocator/compact -d '{"scope":"paged-attn","mode":"immediate"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED'
```
Sam (eng): also drop the backoff change in the next patch — it was too conservative. but do that after stabilization.
Ops Runner: compaction job triggered; logs show compaction pausing due to gpu pressure; forced-run succeeded on node-7. 
Julia (oncall): evict_by_age set to 30s on pool us-west-2-paged. watch heatmap.
Mike (ml): routing note: I can flip a routing override to route 15% of traffic to the non-paged variant (v2.4-compact) to reduce pressure while compaction runs. want me to do that?
Elandra (sre): do it. also enable eviction hysteresis decrease: /ops/allocator/evict-hysteresis=0.1.
Julia (oncall): doing the routing override now. command: ```bash
# temporary routing tweak
redwood route update --pool paged-attn --weight 0.85 --alt-pool non-paged-compact --alt-weight 0.15
```
Incident Bot: Note added: manual compaction & routing override applied by Julia.
Ops Runner: after compaction, free pages on node-7 rose from 12 -> 120k, fragmentation down to 0.45. node restarts stopped on that host.
Sam (eng): good signal. let's patch the compact-scan backoff in staging and schedule a canary tomorrow. for immediate, we should add an emergency GC trigger that runs nightly until we fix backoff logic.
Elandra (sre): agreed. also want to capture a heap profile before we rotate the remaining nodes. Julia, can you snapshot /metrics/allocdump on the two next nodes?
Julia (oncall): snapshotting now, uploading to incident doc: https://confluence/redwood/incidents/1755002468.
Kyle (prod): customer comms: we've had ~120 requests with 5xx in last hour for one enterprise tenant. recommend proactive message: "We observed intermittent inference failures in us-west-2 paged-attention pool; mitigation in progress; you may see retries transparent to the user." want to draft?
Sam (eng): yes, keep it short and avoid internal details. ops can send after we have stabilization window.
Julia (oncall): stabilization window: last OOM seen 02:34 UTC, rolling drains ongoing. marking incident as on-call mitigation.
Elandra (sre): follow-up actions (post-incident): 
- revert compact-scan backoff tweak or tune smarter heuristics
- implement evict_by_age policy with telemetry and safety caps
- add allocator watchdog that triggers forced compaction when fragmentation > 0.8 for > 10m
- add automated routing fallback when paged-pool error-rate > 1%
Mike (ml): also flag model-replay batch — can we rate-limit long-seq replay or schedule it off-peak? prevents recurrence.
Julia (oncall): putting that in the incident ticket. current status: error-rate down to 0.12%, nodes stabilized, compaction completed on top offenders.
Ops Runner: recommending keep monitoring for 6 hours, if stable close incident and start RC (root cause) triage tomorrow.
Kyle (prod): I'll prep a short customer note to post once we hit 2h stable.
Incident Bot: Incident state changed -> mitigation_in_progress by Julia (oncall) at 02:40 UTC
Julia (oncall): handing off to Elandra for overnight watch. Elandra, please pick up and file RC items.
Elandra (sre): acknowledged — will run hourly checks and escalate if fragmentation rises. uploading preliminary RCA in incident doc.
Julia (oncall): thanks everyone. ending active thread.
